verdict.rationale: Gemini, as evidenced here, is a consumer AI assistant app, so it sits in the MCP-client role; serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the pack shows Gemini itself running as an MCP server. The runtime probe found no MCP server card on gemini.google.com, and its Connected Apps feature is client-side integration, which does not make this server axis applicable.
